gloss: to pour down; to shower down; to fall upon

definitions.gloss: to pour down; to shower down
definitions.explanation: to fall continuously and intensely from above, used for rain, sunlight, or other things that come down

examples.japanese: {太陽|たいよう}の{光|ひかり}が{降|ふ}り{注|そそ}ぐ。
{激|はげ}しい{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}り{注|そそ}いだ。
{花火|はなび}の{火|ひ}の{粉|こ}が{夜空|よぞら}から{降|ふ}り{注|そそ}いでいた。
examples.english: Sparks from the fireworks were showering down from the night sky.

notes:
{降|ふ}り{注|そそ}ぐ is a compound verb expressing something pouring or showering down from above.

VERB TYPE: Godan verb (u-verb), intransitive

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {降|ふ}る (to fall - rain, snow)
- {注|そそ}ぐ (to pour)

CONJUGATION:
- {降|ふ}り{注|そそ}がない (negative)
- {降|ふ}り{注|そそ}いだ (past)
- {降|ふ}り{注|そそ}いで (te-form)

COMMON SUBJECTS:
- {雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}り{注|そそ}ぐ (rain pours down)
- {日差|ひざ}しが{降|ふ}り{注|そそ}ぐ (sunlight showers down)
- {光|ひかり}が{降|ふ}り{注|そそ}ぐ (light pours down)
- {雪|ゆき}が{降|ふ}り{注|そそ}ぐ (snow showers down)

FIGURATIVE USE:
- {愛情|あいじょう}を{降|ふ}り{注|そそ}ぐ (to shower with love) - transitive use
- {祝福|しゅくふく}が{降|ふ}り{注|そそ}ぐ (blessings rain down)

NUANCE:
- Implies abundance and intensity
- Often poetic or descriptive
- Evokes imagery of things cascading from above
